profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ Xbox | Search, Discovery & Personalization | Applied AI & Agentic Systems | AI-Driven Development | Enterprise AI Adoption
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft with 25+ years in software development, including 18+ years at Microsoft, building product experiences, distributed services, search and discovery systems, and more recently production-oriented AI systems and agentic workflows.

I work at the intersection of applied AI, software architecture, and business/product workflows. My recent work spans agentic systems, AI-driven software development, context engineering, semantic and hybrid search, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, and LLM orchestration, turning emerging AI capabilities into systems that can operate reliably inside real products and engineering workflows.

My focus is increasingly on how to move from an interesting AI capability to something people actually adopt and depend on. That means identifying high-value workflows, designing the right context and orchestration model, establishing security and safety boundaries, integrating with existing systems, evaluating behavior, measuring outcomes, and creating repeatable patterns that teams can use at scale.

At Xbox, my work has included AI-powered game discovery, semantic and hybrid retrieval, LLM-driven user experiences, agentic product experiences, and AI-driven development workflows in which coding agents take on an increasingly large share of implementation work while engineers focus on intent, architecture, context, validation, and system-level decisions.

Earlier in my career, I helped build and modernize products and platforms across Xbox, Game Pass, Microsoft News, SharePoint, OneDrive, Bing, Windows, and Azure-backed services. That foundation in large-scale product engineering continues to shape how I approach AI: production quality, security, reliability, cost, maintainability, and business value matter as much as model capability.

I’m particularly interested in the next generation of software and enterprise workflows, where AI systems preserve operational context across artifacts, tools, decisions, and organizational boundaries, and can safely move beyond retrieval and generation into useful action.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Gaiming-AI working on advanced AI systems for next-generation Xbox and gaming experiences, with an emphasis on AI-driven development, search and discovery, context engineering, orchestration, and safe execution.

• Co-designed and built a frontier agentic system supporting novel product interactions and dynamic scenarios while treating security and content safety as first-class architectural constraints.
• Advancing AI-driven software development workflows in which coding agents perform a substantial share of implementation tasks while engineers define intent, architecture, context, validation, and acceptance criteria.
• Building custom agent orchestration and context-engineering patterns to improve how agents reason across complex tasks, preserve relevant context, coordinate work, and operate reliably across longer development loops.
• Developing reusable patterns for agent-assisted engineering rather than isolated prompting, with an emphasis on decomposition, feedback loops, validation, and human oversight.
• Partnering across engineering and adjacent disciplines to turn emerging LLM and agent capabilities into product and development workflows that can move beyond experimentation toward repeatable use.
• Scaled AI‑assisted development from the frontier team to the wider org, including a lightweight, security‑focused harness to control tool calls and protect internal data and services.
positions.insights: AI orchestration, Organic Search and +9 skills

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked within the XPC organization on AI-powered capabilities designed to improve how Xbox players discover and engage with games.

•  Led technical exploration and implementation of AI-powered game discovery, combining semantic retrieval with established search and ranking techniques rather than treating LLMs as a replacement for traditional systems.
•  Designed a cost-conscious semantic search architecture over the Xbox games catalog using Azure AI, vector embeddings, and retrieval techniques optimized for production constraints.
•  Developed a hybrid ranking approach using a modified Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) strategy, balancing semantic relevance with product and business ranking requirements.
•  Applied language models to enrich catalog information and improve representations used for embedding and retrieval, enabling richer semantic understanding of games beyond traditional metadata.
•  Orchestrated LLMs for direct user-facing interactions and explored agentic patterns for workflows requiring multi-step reasoning or decision-making.
• Prototyped and evaluated new LLM-supported discovery experiences, using experimentation to determine where generative AI provided meaningful user value versus where conventional search remained the better solution.
• Worked across the retrieval stack, from content representation and embeddings through ranking and LLM interaction, to connect model behavior with the actual game-discovery experience.
positions.insights: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Semantic Search and +5 skills

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer Lead
positions.description:
Led engineering for the Xbox Growth Team within the CPE organization.

• Provided engineering and technical leadership for initiatives focused on improving the Xbox player lifecycle and product growth.
• Set technical direction while partnering across engineering and product disciplines to move initiatives from experimentation through implementation.
• Balanced short-cycle product experimentation with the architectural quality, reliability, and maintainability required in the broader Xbox ecosystem.
• Supported engineers through technical design, implementation decisions, cross-team dependencies, and delivery.
positions.insights: Software Architectural Design, Technical Project Leadership and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Delivered consulting software for Banorte.
• Developed Inspector Móvil, a mobile polling/data-collection application.
• Worked directly with customer requirements and translated operational needs into deployed software.

positions.title: Software Developer and IT Administrator
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a point-of-sale application supporting core business operations.
• Managed networking, routers, and broader IT infrastructure alongside application-development responsibilities.
• Developed early experience owning technology end-to-end: understanding the business problem, building the software, deploying it, and supporting the environment in which it operated.
